Class MoleculeTooltips

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.MoleculeTooltips
public final class MoleculeTooltips extends Object
Extra image space shared by the native Forge, HEI and CodeChickenLib tooltip renderers.
